en: The postcard image depicts a small European town nestled at the foot of an enormous rocky mountain. The town consists of low, pale buildings with red-tiled roofs, and a church with a bell tower is prominent in the foreground. The mountain behind dominates the scene, its sheer cliffs and colorful rock strata a dramatic natural backdrop. The image appears to be colorized or painted, in a style typical of early 20th-century postcards.
